name: poly-steps
description: Layer 2 of polyphony: the per-step note array. Each step stores up to CAP=16 (note,velocity) pairs instead of one byte. Layout: byte0=count, then entries [note,vel] at dst+1+2*i. poly_merge(dst,note,vel) adds or velocity-updates a note (used per note-on); poly_remove(dst,note) removes on note-off; poly_count(dst) returns count. All position-independent.
